removals.reason: The kernel-side protected.manifest and its generator are retired under helm-tracker#330. This gate compared kernel files with hashes regenerated in the same repository. No downstream runtime or sync consumes that file: helm-ai-enterprise/tools/sync-oss-kernel.sh generates its own manifest after rewriting imports, using its own protected-path inventory. Its untracked-file and missing-source checks now run in tracked-file-hygiene through scripts/ci/check_source_tree.py.

The manifest-specific cases lose their subject when the kernel digest manifest is retired. The untracked, ignored and missing-source cases are retained in scripts/ci/check_source_tree_test.py under gate-self-tests, with the checker run by tracked-file-hygiene. Enterprise mirror verification and TCB import isolation remain independently owned and active.
